title: New Look
notes: Completely new art direction: warm dusk skies with clouds, cherry blossoms in the city, an evening shrine in the snow and a sunset arena.
Characters are drawn in color now: faces with eyes, coats in your power's color, boots, belts, ink outlines and cel shading. Your katana is real steel.
Monsters have colored bodies and outlines instead of neon glow.
New menu design: warm gold instead of cyan, rounded buttons, friendlier fonts, no more sci-fi brackets.
